searchText: Updated Electra test vectors to latest `dev` branch commit (`88f5dde`) See Spec test vectors - 2024/04/12: https://notes.ethereum.org/6wvK1EbQQuyHlZNzCopOyA?view#Spec-changes-for-pectra-devnet-0 Any plans for PeerDAS test vectors? The pectra-devnet-0 doc has been updated with the latest EIPs added yesterday: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/pectra-devnet-0 as per the meta-eip merged in yesterday: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8403 Do we want to stick to all EIPs going in devnet-0? Or do we want to choose all EIPs - the bigger ones? why not aim for all of them? just a question of time, if it feels like there's a ~0% chance we'd have any clients ready with all EIPs before interop, then we could start smaller and get some testing cycles in earlier for EIPs that are ready id aim for fewer bigger ones if there’s a question <timbeiko> Agreed, but I'd also like to aim for "everything before interop". Not sure how possible it is to get a similar implementation ordering across all the client teams, though? are any clients worried about not coming to interop with all eips impl'd? i think geth is looking pretty good across all the eips, maybe a week of consolidation work to get One Good Branch? speaking of consolidations, are we doing that on the EL?

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
The pectra-devnet-0 doc has been updated with the latest EIPs added yesterday: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/pectra-devnet-0 as per the meta-eip merged in yesterday: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8403

Do we want to stick to all EIPs going in devnet-0? Or do we want to choose all EIPs - the bigger ones?

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: why not aim for all of them?

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: just a question of time, if it feels like there's a ~0% chance we'd have any clients ready with all EIPs before interop, then we could start smaller and get some testing cycles in earlier for EIPs that are ready

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: id aim for fewer bigger ones if there’s a question

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <timbeiko> Agreed, but I'd also like to aim for "everything before interop". Not sure how possible it is to get a similar implementation ordering across all the client teams, though?

excerpts.content: are any clients worried about not coming to interop with all eips impl'd?
